language.title: Language
language.description: The language of menus, panels and messages.
language.label: Language
language.restartNote: Restart Cloudy Canvas to use the new language. Your work is saved first.

about.description: Boards and designs on one canvas. Part of Cloudy Studio.

dedication.title: Cloudy Studio is for her
dedication.body: Cloudy Studio is named after the name she gives the characters she loves in her games: Cloudy. Every app in this series is dedicated to her, the person who makes every day a little less cloudy.

agents.description: Let AI agents like Claude Code read and edit the open board. Only apps on this computer can connect.

files.description: Boards and designs are saved wherever you choose. The app only remembers which ones you opened.
files.autosaveHint: Saves open files a moment after each change. Boards you haven't saved yet are kept as drafts in the app data folder until you choose where they go.
files.desktopOnly: Kept by the desktop app only.
files.clearHint: Clearing the list leaves the files on disk and keeps drafts.

appearance.description: How the app looks: its colors, fonts and how tight its controls are. Plugins can add themes. Files don't change: exports and previews keep their own colors.
appearance.themeHint: Match system switches with your OS's dark mode.
appearance.densityHint: How tall controls and rows are. A theme has its own; this overrides it.
appearance.missing: “{id}” isn't installed (its plugin was removed or turned off), so a built-in theme is shown instead.

collaboration.description: Share an open board or design live: your app hosts it, and the people you let in edit it with you until you stop.
collaboration.nameHint: Shown to others in live sessions.
collaboration.relayDown: The Cloudy Canvas relay can't be reached right now because of a technical problem, so sessions use public relays (n0) instead. They work the same and stay end-to-end encrypted. The Cloudy Canvas relay is tried again for later sessions.
collaboration.relayAddressError: Enter the relay's address, like https://relay.example.com
collaboration.relayHint: Helps guests reach you through routers, and carries the session when a direct connection can't be made. It never sees your files. Guests use the one in your link.
collaboration.connectBuiltIn: Sessions connect through the Cloudy Canvas relay when a direct connection can't be made. It never sees your files.
collaboration.connectPublic: Sessions connect through public relays (n0) when a direct connection can't be made. They never see your files.
collaboration.connected: Connected through the relay in {millis} ms
collaboration.needDesktop: Live sessions need the desktop app.
collaboration.answersNoToken: The relay answers but didn't let the app in: check the token.
collaboration.unreachable: {error} The server can't be reached: check the address, that it's running and that ports 80, 443 and 7842/udp are open.

shortcuts.description: On a board. Hold Shift while resizing to keep proportions; hold Alt while dragging to duplicate.

plugins.description: Add tools, elements and agent tools to your boards. Changes apply after a reload.
plugins.reloadNote: Reload the app to apply the changes to plugins.
plugins.stopLoading: Stop loading it? Its folder stays.
plugins.trustBody: Plugins run with the same access as the app: your files, the network and your boards. Only turn on plugins you trust.
plugins.trustBodyAuthor: Plugins run with the same access as the app: your files, the network and your boards. Only turn on plugins you trust (this one is by {author}).
plugins.pickInstall: Install a plugin from its folder
plugins.turnOnBelow: Turn it on below, then reload to use it.
